Find the total sales amount handled by each Sales Person in 2012, including:

Employee Full Name

Territory Name

Total Sales Amount

Total Orders Count

Average Order Amount

SELECT
    CONCAT(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vSalesPerson.FirstName, ' ', ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vSalesPerson.MiddleName + ' ', ''), AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vSalesPerson.LastName) AS [Employee Full Name],
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vSalesPerson.TerritoryName,
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue) AS [Total Sales Amount],
    COUNT(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID) AS [Total Orders Count],
    AVG(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue) AS [Average Order Amount]
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vSalesPerson
JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vSalesPerson.BusinessEntityID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesPersonID
WHERE
    YEAR(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate) = 2012
GROUP BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vSalesPerson.BusinessEntityID,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vSalesPerson.FirstName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vSalesPerson.MiddleName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vSalesPerson.LastName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vSalesPerson.TerritoryName

Get a list of all products sold in the 2010, 2011, 2012 months along with their supplier details, including:

Product Name

Product Category

Supplier Name

Total Quantity Sold

Total Sales Amount

SELECT
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name AS [Product Name],
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name AS [Product Category],
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor.Name AS [Supplier Name],
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.OrderQty) AS [Total Quantity Sold],
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.LineTotal) AS [Total Sales Amount]
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.SalesOrderID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductSubcategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductSubcategoryID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductCategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ProductVendor
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ProductVendor.ProductID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ProductVendor.BusinessEntityID = AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor.BusinessEntityID
WHERE
    YEAR(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate) IN (2010, 2011, 2012)
GROUP BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name,
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor.Name
ORDER BY
    [Product Name],
    [Product Category],
    [Supplier Name]

List the top 10 customers who purchased the highest number of products in year 20110,2011,2012, including:

Customer Name

Email Address

Product Name

Product Category

Total Quantity Ordered

Total Sales Amount

WITH TopCustomers AS (
    SELECT TOP 10
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID,
        SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.OrderQty) AS OverallTotalQuantityOrdered
    FROM
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
    INNER JOIN
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.SalesOrderID
    WHERE
        YEAR(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate) IN (2010, 2011, 2012)
    GROUP BY
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID
    ORDER BY
        OverallTotalQuantityOrdered DESC
)
SELECT
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.FirstName + ' ' + ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.MiddleName + ' ', '') + AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.LastName AS "Customer Name",
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.EmailAddress AS "Email Address",
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name AS "Product Name",
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name AS "Product Category",
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.OrderQty) AS "Total Quantity Ordered",
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.LineTotal) AS "Total Sales Amount"
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.SalesOrderID
INNER JOIN
    TopCustomers ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID = TopCustomers.CustomerID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.CustomerID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.PersonID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.BusinessEntityID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductSubcategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductSubcategoryID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductCategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID
WHERE
    YEAR(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate) IN (2010, 2011, 2012)
GROUP BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.FirstName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.MiddleName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.LastName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.EmailAddress,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name,
    TopCustomers.OverallTotalQuantityOrdered
ORDER BY
    TopCustomers.OverallTotalQuantityOrdered DESC,
    "Total Quantity Ordered" DESC

List the top 10 customers who purchased the highest number of products in year 2010,2011,2012, including:
Customer Name

Email Address

Product Name

Product Category

Total Quantity Ordered

Total Sales Amount

WITH CustomerOverallPurchase AS (
    SELECT
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID,
        SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.OrderQty) AS OverallQuantity,
        SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.LineTotal) AS OverallSalesAmount
    FROM
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
    INNER JOIN
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.SalesOrderID
    WHERE
        YEAR(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate) IN (2010, 2011, 2012)
    GROUP BY
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID
),
RankedCustomers AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        OverallQuantity,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY OverallQuantity DESC) AS CustomerRank
    FROM
        CustomerOverallPurchase
)
SELECT
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.FirstName + ' ' + ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.MiddleName + ' ', '') + AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.LastName AS [Customer Name],
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.EmailAddress AS [Email Address],
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name AS [Product Name],
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name AS [Product Category],
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.OrderQty) AS [Total Quantity Ordered],
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.LineTotal) AS [Total Sales Amount]
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.SalesOrderID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.CustomerID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.PersonID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.BusinessEntityID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductSubcategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductSubcategoryID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductCategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID
INNER JOIN
    RankedCustomers ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID = RankedCustomers.CustomerID
WHERE
    YEAR(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate) IN (2010, 2011, 2012)
    AND RankedCustomers.CustomerRank <= 10
GROUP BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.FirstName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.MiddleName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.LastName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.EmailAddress,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name,
    RankedCustomers.CustomerRank,
    RankedCustomers.OverallQuantity
ORDER BY
    RankedCustomers.CustomerRank ASC,
    RankedCustomers.OverallQuantity DESC,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.vIndividualCustomer.FirstName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name

List all products with their category, subcategory, color, size, list price, total units sold, and total revenue.

SELECT
  AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name,
  AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name AS CategoryName,
  AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.Name AS SubcategoryName,
  AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Color,
  AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Size,
  AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ListPrice,
  SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.OrderQty) AS TotalUnitsSold,
  SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.LineTotal) AS TotalRevenue
FROM AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product
LEFT JOIN AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory
  ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductSubcategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductSubcategoryID
LEFT JOIN AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory
  ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductCategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID
LEFT JOIN AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail
  ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID
GROUP BY
  AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name,
  AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name,
  AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.Name,
  AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Color,
  AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Size,
  AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ListPrice
ORDER BY
  AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name

Show all products with their category, subcategory, color, size, and list price. Include how many units were sold, total sales revenue, inventory quantity, and reorder level. Calculate average monthly sales for the last 3 years. Highlight products that sold less than 20% of their category’s total sales. Use these tables: Production.Product, Production.ProductSubcategory, Production.ProductCategory, Production.ProductInventory, and Sales.SalesOrderDetail.

WITH ProductSales AS (
    SELECT
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID,
        SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.OrderQty) AS TotalUnitsSold,
        SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.LineTotal) AS TotalSalesRevenue,
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate >= DATEADD(year, -3, GETDATE()) THEN AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.LineTotal
                ELSE 0
            END) AS SalesRevenueLast3Years
    FROM AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail
    INNER JOIN AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
        ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.SalesOrderID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID
    GROUP BY
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID
),
ProductInventorySummary AS (
    SELECT
        AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductInventory.ProductID,
        SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductInventory.Quantity) AS InventoryQuantity
    FROM AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductInventory
    GROUP BY
        AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductInventory.ProductID
),
CategorySales AS (
    SELECT
        AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID,
        SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.LineTotal) AS TotalCategorySales
    FROM AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product
    INNER JOIN AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory
        ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductSubcategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductSubcategoryID
    INNER JOIN AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory
        ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductCategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID
    INNER JOIN AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail
        ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID
    GROUP BY
        AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID
)
SELECT
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name AS ProductName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name AS CategoryName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.Name AS SubcategoryName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Color,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Size,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ListPrice,
    ISNULL(ProductSales.TotalUnitsSold, 0) AS TotalUnitsSold,
    ISNULL(ProductSales.TotalSalesRevenue, 0) AS TotalSalesRevenue,
    ISNULL(ProductInventorySummary.InventoryQuantity, 0) AS InventoryQuantity,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ReorderPoint,
    ISNULL(ProductSales.SalesRevenueLast3Years / 36.0, 0) AS AverageMonthlySalesForLast3Years,
    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(CategorySales.TotalCategorySales, 0) > 0
             AND ISNULL(ProductSales.TotalSalesRevenue, 0) < (0.20 * CategorySales.TotalCategorySales)
        THEN 'Highlight: Less than 20% of Category Sales'
        ELSE 'Normal'
    END AS SalesContributionStatus
FROM AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product
LEFT JOIN AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductSubcategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductSubcategoryID
LEFT JOIN AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductCategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID
LEFT JOIN ProductSales
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID = ProductSales.ProductID
LEFT JOIN ProductInventorySummary
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID = ProductInventorySummary.ProductID
LEFT JOIN CategorySales
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID = CategorySales.ProductCategoryID
ORDER BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.Name,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name;

Show all products with these columns: Product Name, Category, Subcategory, Color, Size, List Price, Units Sold, Total Revenue, Inventory Quantity, and Reorder Level. Use these tables: Production.Product, Production.ProductSubcategory, Production.ProductCategory, Production.ProductInventory, and Sales.SalesOrderDetail

SELECT
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name AS "Product Name",
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name AS Category,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.Name AS Subcategory,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Color,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Size,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ListPrice AS "List Price",
    ISNULL(SalesAgg.UnitsSold, 0) AS "Units Sold",
    ISNULL(SalesAgg.TotalRevenue, 0.00) AS "Total Revenue",
    ISNULL(InventoryAgg.InventoryQuantity, 0) AS "Inventory Quantity",
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ReorderPoint AS "Reorder Level"
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductSubcategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductSubcategoryID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductCategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID
LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID,
            SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.OrderQty) AS UnitsSold,
            SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.LineTotal) AS TotalRevenue
        FROM
            AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail
        GROUP BY
            AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID
    ) AS SalesAgg ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID = SalesAgg.ProductID
LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductInventory.ProductID,
            SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductInventory.Quantity) AS InventoryQuantity
        FROM
            AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductInventory
        GROUP BY
            AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductInventory.ProductID
    ) AS InventoryAgg ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID = InventoryAgg.ProductID
Show all orders with Order Date, Ship Date, Customer, Product, Quantity, Total Due, Shipping Method, and Order Status

SELECT
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.ShipDate,
    CASE
        WHEN AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.FirstName, ' ', AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.LastName)
        WHEN AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.StoreID IS NOT NULL THEN AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.Name
        ELSE 'Unknown Customer'
    END AS Customer,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name AS Product,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.OrderQty AS Quantity,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue,
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.Name AS Shipping_Method,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.Status AS Order_Status
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.SalesOrderID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.PersonID = AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.BusinessEntityID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.StoreID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.BusinessEntityID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.ShipMethodID = AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.ShipMethodID
Show suppliers with their products name, unit cost, total units purchased, total purchase cost, and product category. Include top 10 suppliers by purchase volume.

SELECT
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor.Name AS SupplierName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name AS ProductName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice,
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail.OrderQty AS TotalUnitsPurchased,
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail.LineTotal AS TotalPurchaseCost,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name AS ProductCategory
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderHeader
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor.BusinessEntityID = AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderHeader.PurchaseOrderID = AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail.PurchaseOrderID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductSubcategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductSubcategoryID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductCategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID
WHERE
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor.BusinessEntityID IN (
        SELECT TOP 10 AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID
        FROM
            AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderHeader
        INNER JOIN
            AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail
            ON AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderHeader.PurchaseOrderID = AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail.PurchaseOrderID
        GROUP BY
            AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID
        ORDER BY
            SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail.LineTotal) DESC
    )
ORDER BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor.Name,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name

Show all orders with Order Date, Ship Date, Customer, Product, Quantity, Total Due, Shipping Method, and Order Status. Include total revenue by shipping method and top 10 customers. Use tables: Sales.SalesOrderHeader, Sales.SalesOrderDetail, Sales.Customer, Production.Product, Sales.ShipMethod.

SELECT
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.ShipDate,
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.FirstName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.MiddleName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.LastName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.Name AS StoreName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name AS ProductName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.OrderQty,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue,
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.Name AS ShippingMethodName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.Status
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.SalesOrderID
JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID
JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.PersonID = AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.BusinessEntityID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.StoreID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.BusinessEntityID
JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.ShipMethodID = AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.ShipMethodID;

SELECT
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.Name AS ShippingMethodName,
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue) AS TotalRevenueByShippingMethod
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.ShipMethodID = AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.ShipMethodID
GROUP BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.Name
ORDER BY
    TotalRevenueByShippingMethod DESC;

SELECT TOP 10
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.CustomerID,
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.FirstName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.MiddleName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.LastName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.Name AS StoreName,
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue) AS CustomerTotalDue
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.PersonID = AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.BusinessEntityID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.StoreID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.BusinessEntityID
GROUP BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.CustomerID,
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.FirstName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.MiddleName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.LastName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.Name
ORDER BY
    CustomerTotalDue DESC;
